dslRule:
<!id: string-redundant-constructor>
<!description: Replace redundant new String(String) constructor with the string itself.
This transformation is safe only when the constructor argument is already a java.lang.String.
It avoids unnecessary object creation, improving performance and code readability.
It will not apply to constructors like new String(char[]) or new String(byte[]).>
<!severity: HINT>

new java.lang.String($x) :: instanceof($x, "java.lang.String")
=> $x
;;
summary: Replaces redundant new java.lang.String($x) with $x when $x is already a String, improving performance and readability.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
